answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 49403 Country: Pakistan Title: Engineering Job in Bank Question: Is network engineer job halal in bank? If halal, can I think of it makruh (disliked)? Note: Network Engineer work is to install routers/switches nationwide for interconnectivity of branches and data servers. Answer ID: 49403 Posted on: Aug 8, 2022 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1816/1458/B=12/1434) Perhaps, a network engineer is not entitled to write or check interest based accounts, rather he is responsible to connect server with other machine as an engineer, if he does only such type of work, then apparently such a job is lawful. But since the banks operate on interest money and the salary one gets is from the same category, therefore it is preferable to look for any lawful job. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
